ceiling_directive: Prove an observable estimator attaining the n^{-4β/(4β+d)} quadratic rate over the published SmoothCOT density class, or prove an inclusion transferring such achievability, thereby converting the transferred bracket into a sharp same-class minimax result.
improvement_directive: Resolve the observable mixed-calibration question by proving relative Hilbert–Schmidt kernel consistency without D log(n)/n → 0, then establish a common-multiplier coupling and anti-concentration bound yielding the stated uniform coverage and width.
critique: For d≥1, the central minimax theorem proves an intrinsic lower frontier but only a strictly slower observable upper envelope, so it does not determine the quadratic-zone rate. The growing-rank transition applies only to an infeasible population-score, population-kernel statistic, while the load-bearing observable mixed-regime calibration remains open. The isotropic transfer is likewise an unmatched bracket on a class constructed in the note rather than a resolution of the published SmoothCOT class. The TL;DR inaccurately attributes the entire lower frontier to the sign-paired family: its rho/sqrt(n) component actually requires the separate fixed-frequency two-point construction. The public [direct-COT](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.00257v2) and [SmoothCOT](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.20681v1) theorem texts support the cited global rates and regular CLT only, not equality-local optimality or observable mixed calibration.
